packageRules.description: Appium major/minor upgrades have broken the e2e tests and needed a refactor. Patch only. Renovate does not override disabled dependencies for vulnerability alerts, so this also silences CVE-driven major/minor bumps.
appium-tests/.python-version is pinned to the interpreter the e2e tests are known to work on. Moving it is a decision, not maintenance.
Pinned to a JitPack commit on purpose - see the TODO in gradle/libs.versions.toml
Compose BOM and the explicitly-versioned material3 artifacts move in lockstep
Kotlin and all Kotlin plugins share one version key
Play-flavour only, not built for F-Droid
